# `company.shipments`

Shipments: a dated stock document issuing an order's units ahead of the invoice. Immutable; its state is its newest revision.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this shipment. |
| `number` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | unique | — | — | Shipment number, from the shipment sequence. |
| `sales_order_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipments_order | work_documents.id | Sales order the shipment fills. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipments_customer | customers.id | Customer or job the goods went to: the order's. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | transactions.id | Journal entry the shipment posts as (inventory_documents kind shipment). |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this shipment was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this shipment. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this shipment. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this shipment. |
